item.statement: The candidate must keep the same interface structure: odata is binary32 row-major storage of shape [height,pitch], pitch/width/height/shiftX/shiftY are i32 scalars, and the logical operation covers exactly width-by-height with pitch used only as row stride.

plans.objective: Verify data types, row-major layout, and pitch semantics of the future Ascend-C candidate.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate source artifact and read the kernel body and parameter declarations.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff the candidate uses binary32 elements, i32 scalars, row stride pitch, and logical width/height bounds, and does not require cudaTextureObject_t.
plans.setup: Inspect the candidate kernel signature and indexing expressions; confirm element type is float32, scalar parameters are signed 32-bit, and row indexing uses y*pitch+x while the column count is logical width.
